The '''GR-10 Plasma Core Blaster''' was a model of plasma [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The GR-10 Plasma Core Blaster was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Outer Rim Explorer's Pack, which was released to the Cartel Market on [[July 22]], [[2015]].
